author: Nick Bellows
description:
Detects schtasks.exe creating a task that either runs as SYSTEM or whose action points at a
user-writable location (AppData, Temp, Users\Public) or a script host / shell (powershell,
cmd /c, mshta, wscript, cscript, rundll32, regsvr32). This is the shape of Atomic Red Team
T1053.005 tests 1 and 2. Tasks created through the Task Scheduler COM API or PowerShell
cmdlets (tests 4, 6) do not spawn schtasks.exe and need Security 4698 telemetry instead.
ATT&CK Enterprise v19.2 and the Atomic test catalog were accessed 2026-08-29.
false_positives: Software installers and update agents that register SYSTEM tasks; allowlist by parent process and task name rather than disabling the SYSTEM clause.
Administrative deployment scripts that create tasks running PowerShell maintenance jobs.
name: SIGMA - Scheduled Task Created to Run as SYSTEM or From a User-Writable Path or Script Host
query: winlog.channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (event.code:1 AND (process.executable.caseless:*\\schtasks.exe AND process.command_line:*\/create* AND ((process.command_line:(*\/ru\ system* OR *\/ru\ \"system\"* OR *\/ru\ nt\ authority\\system* OR *\/ru\ \"nt\ authority\\system\"*)) OR (process.command_line:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *powershell* OR *pwsh* OR *cmd.exe\ \/c* OR *cmd\ \/c* OR *mshta* OR *wscript* OR *cscript* OR *rundll32* OR *regsvr32*)))))
